design_system.name: BidFlow Design System
design_system.description: A high-performance, minimalist auction interface prioritizing data clarity, trust, and speed. Uses a 'Swiss Style' aesthetic with high contrast and strict grids.

usage.surface_card: bg-white border border-border/60 shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-all duration-300

buttons.primary: rounded-full px-8 py-6 text-base font-bold tracking-wide transition-transform active:scale-95
buttons.secondary: rounded-full px-6 py-4 bg-secondary text-secondary-foreground hover:bg-secondary/80

cards.auction_item: group relative overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-border bg-white p-0 transition-all hover:border-accent/50
cards.stat_card: rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface p-6 flex flex-col justify-between h-full

inputs.default: h-12 rounded-lg border-input bg-transparent px-4 py-2 text-sm shadow-sm transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-1 focus-visible:ring-ring disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50

instructions_to_main_agent: 2. FONTS: Add 'Chivo', 'Manrope', and 'JetBrains Mono' via Google Fonts in index.html or CSS.
3. THEME: Implement the 'Swiss Precision' color palette in tailwind.config.js. Use CSS variables for flexibility.
4. LAYOUT: Use the 'Bento Grid' strategy for the dashboard. Avoid equal-sized cards; vary spans for visual interest.
5. COMPONENTS: Build a 'LiveAuctionCard' component that features a countdown timer (using JetBrains Mono) and a 'Place Bid' button.
6. REAL-TIME: Use 'sonner' for toast notifications when a new bid is placed.
7. ACCESSIBILITY: Ensure all text meets APCA contrast standards. Use 'data-testid' on all interactive elements.
8. ANTI-PATTERNS: Do NOT use gradients for backgrounds. Use solid colors or subtle noise textures. Do NOT use 'Inter' font.
9. IMAGES: Use the provided Unsplash URLs for placeholders. Do not leave image sources empty.
universal_guidelines: Avoid 'AI slop' aesthetics (generic centered layouts, gradients).
Use 2-3x more spacing than typical designs.
